jobs.description: Job Application for Legal Counsel at Securitize Back to jobs Legal Counsel United States Apply Securitize, the leader in tokenizing real-world assets with $3.7B+ AUM (as of May 5, 2025), is bringing the world on-chain through tokenized funds in partnership with top-tier asset managers, such as Apollo, BlackRock, Hamilton Lane, KKR, and others. Securitize, through its subsidiaries, is a SEC-registered broker dealer, digital transfer agent, fund administrator, and operator of a SEC-regulated Alternative Trading System (ATS). Securitize is a global, fully remote team consisting of top talent from the blockchain and financial services industries. Having raised $170M overall to date, we are backed by some of the largest names in finance and technology, including BlackRock, Morgan Stanley, Blockchain Capital, MUFG, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Sony Finance, Banco Santander, Coinbase, among others. Securitize has also been recognized as a 2025 Forbes Top 50 Fintech company. Before applying, we encourage you to visit us to learn more: Website | X/Twitter | LinkedIn We are seeking a Legal Counsel to join our growing legal team. This role is well-suited for an attorney with 3–7 years of experience who is comfortable operating in regulated environments and has hands-on experience with digital assets and SEC-regulated entities . The Legal Counsel will provide legal support across regulatory, transactional, and operational matters, working closely with product, compliance, operations, and external advisors. This is a remote role with meaningful responsibility and exposure to cutting-edge securities and digital asset issues. Key Responsibilities Advise on legal and regulatory matters related to digital assets, tokenized securities, and related products Support compliance with U.S. securities laws and regulations applicable to SEC-regulated entities Work closely with compliance and business teams on regulatory initiatives, product launches, and ongoing operations Coordinate with and manage external counsel on securities, regulatory, and transactional matters Assist with drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial and strategic agreements Support regulatory examinations, audits, and information requests Contribute to the development and maintenance of internal legal and compliance policies Monitor regulatory developments affecting digital assets and securities markets Qualifications (Must Have) JD from an accredited law school Active member in good standing of at least one U.S. state bar 3–7 years of relevant legal experience Prior experience working with digital assets or blockchain-based financial products Prior experience with one or more SEC-regulated entities , such as: Broker-dealer Investment adviser Transfer agent Alternative trading system (ATS) Qualifications (Nice to Have) Prior public company experience Experience advising private funds Experience with registered investment companies Familiarity with fund administration or service provider oversight Experience working cross-functionally in fast-moving or innovative environments Why Join Us? Become a part of our rapidly expanding organization and enjoy a supportive and rewarding work environment: Flexible Paid Time Off – Promoting a healthy work-life balance. Equity Grant Opportunities – Share in the success and future growth of the company. Remote Work Flexibility – Work from anywhere while staying connected with a dynamic and collaborative team. Additional Benefits for US employees Comprehensive Insurance Coverage – Employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family. 401(k) Retirement Plan – Secure your financial future with employer-sponsored savings. Securitize is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital or family status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions at Securitize are based on job-related qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. Before applying, we encourage you to visit us to learn more: Website | X/Twitter | LinkedIn About the Role Transfer Agency and Issuer Services are two critical functions on the Securitize Platform: one keeps investor records accurate through every subscription, redemption, and reconciliation; the other provides the tools needed to bring new assets onto the platform and manages them through their full lifecycle. As a Product Manager spanning both core areas you will work with senior PMs to refine what Operations, Compliance, and institutional clients need into requirements Engineering can successfully build from. What You'll Do Contribute to defining, scoping, and prioritizing product requirements for Transfer Agency and Issuer Operations within the existing product team structure Scope and drive data integrations with partner organizations, from requirements through launch Write and prioritize user stories, specs, and acceptance criteria for features touching investor recordkeeping, subscriptions/redemptions, and cap table management Lead day-to-day delivery with Engineering on onboarding and issuance workflows for new funds/assets joining the Securitize Platform Manage UAT and QA planning for TA and Issuer related releases Prioritize the bug/enhancement backlog from Operations and Compliance based on regulatory and client impact Maintain and continuously improve product documentation, runbooks, and internal training materials for TA and issuer workflows Use operational data (reconciliation exceptions, processing times, error rates) to inform roadmap decisions Coordinate cross-functional launches involving Compliance, Legal, and Client Services What We're Looking For 3–5 years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry Track record of driving a product area day-to-day — from requirements through launch and iteration Strong written and verbal communication — able to write specs Engineering can build from with minimal back-and-forth Ability to translate operational and regulatory needs into product requirements and contribute to trade-off decisions within an established product team framework Working knowledge of common data integration patterns (APIs, file feeds, webhooks) — enough to scope integrations and troubleshoot with Engineering; a dev background isn't required Comfortable managing multiple concurrent work streams and stakeholders across Engineering, Compliance, and Operations Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience Nice to Have Prior exposure to transfer agency, fund administration, or securities operations Familiarity with blockchain/digital asset concepts (tokenization, smart contracts) Experience with JIRA, Confluence, or similar product tools Interest in regulatory-driven products (SEC, FINRA, KYC/AML) What We Offer Competitive salary + equity Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage Flexible work arrangements Learning and development budget Opportunity to work at the intersection of blockchain, finance, and regulatory innovation Why Join Us? Equity Grant Opportunities – Share in the success and future growth of the company. Remote Work Flexibility – Work from anywhere while staying connected with a dynamic and collaborative team. Additional Benefits for US employees Comprehensive Insurance Coverage – Employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family. 401(k) Retirement Plan – Secure your financial future with employer-sponsored savings. jobs.title: Associate, Fund Operations United States
jobs.description: Job Application for Associate, Fund Operations at Securitize Back to jobs Associate, Fund Operations United States Apply Securitize, the leader in tokenizing real-world assets with $3.7B+ AUM (as of May 5, 2025), is bringing the world on-chain through tokenized funds in partnership with top-tier asset managers, such as Apollo, BlackRock, Hamilton Lane, KKR, and others. Securitize, through its subsidiaries, is a SEC-registered broker dealer, digital transfer agent, fund administrator, and operator of a SEC-regulated Alternative Trading System (ATS). Securitize is a global, fully remote team consisting of top talent from the blockchain and financial services industries. Having raised $170M overall to date, we are backed by some of the largest names in finance and technology, including BlackRock, Morgan Stanley, Blockchain Capital, MUFG, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Sony Finance, Banco Santander, Coinbase, among others. Securitize has also been recognized as a 2025 Forbes Top 50 Fintech company. Before applying, we encourage you to visit us to learn more: Website | X/Twitter | LinkedIn About Securitize Capital Securitize Capital is a registered investment adviser and investment manager focused on bringing traditional investment products on-chain through tokenization. Securitize Capital currently serves as investment manager to eight investment funds spanning private equity, private credit, CLOs, high-yield credit and other alternative investment strategies. Our funds combine traditional investment management and fund infrastructure with blockchain-based ownership and transaction capabilities, providing a unique opportunity to help build the operational framework for the next generation of investment products. We are seeking an Associate, Fund Operations to support the day-to-day operations of Securitize Capital's investment funds and help build scalable operational processes as the platform continues to grow. What You'll Do The Associate will work closely with the Securitize Capital team and a broad group of internal and external partners, including fund administrators, auditors, tax providers, custodians, transfer agents, sub-advisers and other service providers. Responsibilities will include: Fund Operations & Financial Oversight Review daily, monthly and quarterly fund financials, NAV calculations and supporting reports prepared by fund administrators. Review fund-level activity, including subscriptions, redemptions, investment activity, cash movements, expenses, management fees and expense accruals. Assist with cash and liquidity management across the funds. Help identify and resolve NAV, accounting, reconciliation and operational discrepancies. Fund Accounting, Audit & Tax Coordinate with third-party fund administrators on accounting and financial reporting matters. Support annual fund audits, including coordinating information and responding to requests from auditors. Coordinate with tax preparers on annual tax filings, investor tax reporting and related information requests. Assist with the review of audited financial statements and other periodic fund reporting. Maintain organized records and supporting documentation for fund expenses, invoices, accruals and other financial activity. Service Provider & Internal Coordination Serve as an operational point of contact for fund administrators, auditors, tax providers, custodians, sub-advisers and other third-party service providers. Coordinate across Securitize Capital and affiliated teams, including fund administration and transfer agency functions. Track open operational items and ensure issues are appropriately escalated and resolved. Tokenized Fund Operations Develop an understanding of how blockchain-based fund interests interact with traditional fund accounting, custody and transfer agency infrastructure. Support operational workflows involving digital assets and stablecoins, including subscription and redemption activity where applicable. What We're Looking For Approximately 2–5 years of experience in fund operations, fund accounting, asset management, fund administration, audit or a related financial-services role. Experience reviewing private fund financial statements, NAVs, capital activity or fund accounting records. Strong understanding of basic investment fund accounting concepts, including NAV, subscriptions and redemptions, management fees, fund expenses, accruals and cash reconciliation. Strong attention to detail and an ability to independently investigate discrepancies. Comfortable working in an environment where processes are still being built and standardized. Strong Excel skills and an ability to work effectively with financial and operational data. Helpful Experience Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable: Private investment funds, including private equity, private credit, hedge funds or other alternative investment vehicles. Fund administration or fund accounting. Investment advisers or registered investment advisers. Digital assets, blockchain technology, tokenized securities or stablecoins. Alternative investments such as private credit, CLOs, high-yield bonds or private equity. Prior digital asset experience is helpful but not required . We are primarily looking for someone with strong fund-operations fundamentals who is interested in learning how traditional investment fund infrastructure can operate using blockchain technology. Who Will Succeed in This Role The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys understanding how a fund works from end to end rather than focusing on only one part of the accounting or operational process. You should be comfortable moving between detailed financial review and broader operational problem-solving. Whether that means reviewing a NAV, investigating a reconciliation difference, coordinating an audit request, documenting a new procedure or helping determine how a new tokenized fund workflow should operate.
